'''Gak's''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] that operated on [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives ventured to the bar to rendezvous with the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Corl'ya]].

==Description==
Gak's was a seedy [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] that operated on [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]],<ref name="Child of Light" /> a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] in [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The bar had a similar atmosphere to the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]]<ref name="Child of Light" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref>

==History==
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tutti Snibit]] often frequented Gak's.<ref name="TNSMS">{{SW|url=news/the-not-so-magnificent-seven|text=The Not-So Magnificent Seven|int=The Not-So Magnificent Seven|nolive=1}}</ref> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]<ref name="Date">"[[Child of Light]]" is set four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], an event that is dated by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' to the sixth month of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. As the ''Atlas'' states that there are twelve months in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]], it can therefore be inferred that ''Child of Light'' takes place in the tenth month of 3 ABY.</ref> a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives assembled at Gak's to rendezvous with the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Rebel [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Corl'ya]]. However, Cor'lya did not make an appearance at the bar and after the operatives had been waiting for an hour they left Gak's to return to their [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="Child of Light" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gak's was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] roleplaying adventure ''[[Child of Light]]'', written by [[Lee Pickler]] and published by [[RPGA]] in [[2000]].<ref name="Child of Light" /> The bar was later referenced in ''[[The Not-So Magnificent Seven]]'', a [[2013]] [[StarWars.com]] blog entry by [[Greg Mitchell]].<ref name="TNSMS" />
